The WhatsApp number is fixed by the brief; the template name/language must match whatever you actually get approved in the Meta App Dashboard — see README's Phase 4 section for the exact submission steps. Until a template is approved, template_name is a placeholder and the template fallback path will fail (correctly logging loudly rather than pretending to succeed).
